research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Airtable is researching systems for managing and manipulating data within server environments, as seen in 'Database with integrated generative ai,' which integrates generative AI fields for natural language requests. 'Record templates' focuses on templates for creating data objects with dynamically calculated fields. 'Constructing and enforcing access control policies' addresses user and element permissions. Other areas include automatic data type detection, partial table synchronization, and email-based data transfer and synchronization.

about_short_description.short_description: Airtable is a cloud-based work management platform that combines databases, workflows, automations, and AI tools in a shared workspace.

product.name: Airtable Platform
product.description: A cloud-based, no-code work management and app-building platform for organizing relational data, creating workflows, and collaborating across teams.

product.name: Airtable AI
product.description: AI functionality embedded in Airtable for summarizing, classifying, generating, analyzing, and transforming information within business workflows.

product.name: Airtable AI App Building
product.description: A conversational, no-code application-building capability that generates business apps from natural-language requirements or existing spreadsheets.

product.name: Airtable AI Agents
product.description: Workflow agents that use Airtable data to perform analysis, make classifications, and automate actions such as approvals, follow-ups, and record updates.

product.name: Airtable Portals
product.description: Airtable-based external collaboration spaces that let organizations share selected workflows and information with users outside their organization.

product.name: Airtable HyperDB
product.description: A high-scale data layer for storing and operating on Airtable datasets containing up to hundreds of millions of records.
